device.title: Set up Walking Pad
device.description: Enter a name and the Walking Pad's Bluetooth MAC address. Turn on the Walking Pad and disconnect it from the mobile app before continuing.

abort.already_configured: This Walking Pad is already configured.

data_description.garmin_account: Preselect this account in WalkingPad sessions and use it for phone approvals.
data_description.notification_device: Choose a Home Assistant Companion App device for upload approval. Clear this field to turn off phone prompts.
data_description.minimum_moving_seconds: Send phone prompts for sessions at or above this moving time. Shorter sessions are still saved.
